goal: Bind the merge-queue gate to the authorized PR head under the verifyGitEvidence ancestor+evidence-tail rule with set-equality tail checking, and refresh the exact-head-approval disposition site so Tools offline tests pass.
prohibited_actions: Do not change any migration or database object.
assumptions: Authorization binds to the implementation head; a pure evidence tail on the live tip is lawful.
A lawful tail is set-equality with one complete evidence pair, matching verifyGitEvidence.
workIssue binding is enforced when the caller supplies it; production set-equality does not require it.
stop_conditions: A change would weaken exact-head containment rather than re-bind it to the authorized head.
